question: Explain whether every constitutional monarch has the same executive powers.
raw: O1: [S5] Not every constitutional monarch has the same executive powers. The powers of constitutional monarchs vary, with some having virtually no executive or policy-making power and primarily serving as a hereditary symbolic head of state, while others retain meaningful formal powers such as veto power, appointment power, and the power to dissolve parliament.
